The '''Bastion customs station''' was a space station orbiting [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. It was the waypoint for all travel to and from Bastion and outside the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] met aboard it to discuss [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] help in fighting the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="KOTOR">[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]</ref>
